experiment.title: Untrimmed +/-1% output-accuracy claim by Monte Carlo, with PNP/resistor/MOS contributor breakdown
experiment.claim: README.md 'Target specification (DRAFT)' row 'Output reference' (1.20 V +/-1% untrimmed) -- the MISMATCH half of that claim. sim/output-voltage-tc/ (issue #11) already shows global process/supply corners move VREF(27 degC) by well under 0.2%; this record measures the local-mismatch spread that corner runs cannot see: PNP pair, PTAT/output res_high_po ratio, and mirror/amp MOS device mismatch, sampled together (the actual untrimmed distribution) and each in isolation (the contributor breakdown #13/#15 need), at nominal process and at both temperature extremes. Records are PROVISIONAL against the draft spec until issue #1 ratifies it, per the same convention #11's records use.
experiment.statistical_convention: N = 30 Monte Carlo samples per mismatch point (N = 15 for control points), local mismatch only (section tt_mm: MC_MM_SWITCH=1, MC_PR_SWITCH=0); 1 sigma sample standard deviation (N-1), fixed setseed 20260803 (second-seed point 20260804)

mismatch_model.switch: MC_MM_SWITCH (set by the .lib section: 0 in tt/ss/ff/sf/fs, 1 in *_mm)
mismatch_model.isolation_mechanism: each family's mismatch sigma coefficient is an ordinary top-level .param; redefining it to 0 AFTER the .lib <section> include silences that family's AGAUSS() contribution while MC_MM_SWITCH stays 1 for every other family -- verified empirically against the pinned PDK

points.purpose: all three mismatch families active -- the untrimmed accuracy distribution this issue's yield claim is read from

checks.name: mc_solve_yield
checks.detail: 24/30 draws converged to the operating solution (VOUT in 0.9..1.5 V); 6 landed on the core's other stable branch and are excluded from every statistic. This is a STARTUP observation (issue #10 -- no startup circuit exists), not a mismatch one, and is sensitive to tb_vref_tc.sch's own .nodeset (reused unmodified here per this issue's reference-only note on #11's testbench). Excluded VOUT values: 0.5419 V, 0.5031 V, 0.4826 V, 0.6393 V, 0.5560 V, 0.5752 V
